parsed.reason: The acknowledgment simply parrots the parent's own words back verbatim ("Zoé is 5 and André is 7"), which reads like a database echo rather than a natural human reply. It adds no warmth and proves it "read" the message only by repeating it mechanically. A plain "Got it — Zoé (5) and André (7)" or even just "Got it — Zoé and André, thanks!" would feel more like a person and less like a receipt. The robotic restatement is the core flaw penalised here.
